={
  "model": "llama3.2:latest",
  "prompt": "Today's date is {{ $json.currentDate }} ({{ $json.currentDayOfWeek }}).
User message: '{{ $json.userMessage }}'

Classify the intent into WRITE (logging production/sales/meters/edits) or READ (queries/totals/reports).
If WRITE, extract:
- target_date (YYYY-MM-DD). IF NO DATE IS MENTIONED, YOU MUST USE {{ $json.currentDate }}.
- production_kg (number or null)
- sales (object mapping vendor name to kg, e.g. {"Vendor A": 5})
- meter_1 (number or null)
- meter_2 (number or null)

If READ, extract:
- start_date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- end_date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- read_query (short string describing the question)

Output ONLY valid JSON. YOU MUST NEST THE DATA INSIDE A 'payload' OBJECT like this:
{
  "intent": "WRITE",
  "target_date": "YYYY-MM-DD",
  "payload": {
    "production_kg": null,
    "sales": {},
    "meter_1": null,
    "meter_2": null
  }
}",
  "stream": false
}

parameters.text: ❓ Sorry, I couldn't clearly parse whether you wanted to log data or read records. Please try rephrasing your message.
